reviews.title: Much more than expected
reviews.comment: This was cheaper than 64gb non RGB Ram and I could not be happier. Very nice quality. Ease of use is more suited to a little more than novice user. Installion scared me and i thought i broke the computer but I just had to reset the cmos and reboot and change the settings to correct the expo settings becuase the voltage was incorrect. I did get it fixed after a few minutes. I have this running on a ryzen 7 9700.
reviews.author: TruFury

reviews.title: Good ram
reviews.comment: Works great. Best Buy shipped it to me quickly and without any issues. Better gb/$ ratio than many other options.
